purpose: Exposed regression evidence; never use these queries as an untouched promotion holdout.

source.provenance: Public BEIR SciFact, SHA256 536e14446a0ba56ed1398ab1055f39fe852686ecad24a6306c80c490fa8e0165. Entire 5183-document corpus; title + newline + abstract. All 300 official test queries and original relevance judgments. Development: first 50 numeric train IDs excluding exact test-text duplicates; no tuning. Qrels are sparse: unjudged is not proven irrelevant. Report judged recall, not exhaustive recall. SciFact: https://github.com/allenai/scifact; BEIR: https://github.com/beir-cellar/beir. Dataset distribution license CC-BY-SA-4.0; raw texts stay outside this repository.

conditions.cache: one warmup pass; RocksDB/OS caches not flushed; no retrieval-result cache
conditions.limits_kind: experimental trial budgets within implementation ceilings; not tenant policy
conditions.ranking_parameters: immutable server profiles; no tuning on test queries

reported_ties.method: Post-hoc permutations only within exactly tied scores in the returned top10; unchanged result set; not a new retrieval run, no proposed ranker, no unseen rank11 cutoff bound.

resources.scope: entire container including telemetry commands and any concurrent clients; memory peak is since container start, not isolated trial peak

lexical.method: paired query bootstrap, 2000 draws, percentile 95%; exploratory, no multiplicity correction

semantic.method: paired query bootstrap, 2000 draws, percentile 95%; exploratory, no multiplicity correction
